objective: Test whether exact component identity can be compressed after count repair by aggregating component multiplicities inside frozen frontier-relative structural descriptor classes and then applying the same Z/O/E count state.

frozenCountState.name: ZOE
frozenCountState.definition: For each retained structural identity: omit zero count, emit O for positive odd total multiplicity, emit E for positive even total multiplicity.

frozenDescriptorCandidates.name: EXACT_ZOE
frozenDescriptorCandidates.definition: Exact canonical component type is the retained identity; this is the established scalar control.

frozenDescriptorCandidates.name: REL_INC_ZOE
frozenDescriptorCandidates.definition: Map every exact component type to the frozen REL_INC owner-preserving residual/column incidence descriptor with exact frontier-relative depths; sum multiplicities over equal REL_INC descriptors; apply ZOE to the aggregate count.

frozenDescriptorCandidates.name: TOPO_RPAR_ZOE
frozenDescriptorCandidates.definition: Map every exact component type to the frozen TOPO_RPAR descriptor with residual/column incidence topology and F/O/E release labels; sum multiplicities over equal descriptors; apply ZOE to the aggregate count.

antiCircularity: REL_INC and TOPO_RPAR were defined before the current count-aggregation experiment.
The aggregation rule is fixed before scalar qualification: counts are summed by descriptor identity first, then classified as zero/positive-odd/positive-even.
No W/D/L label selects a descriptor, component merge, count state, or phase grade.
No rank grade is added in this experiment.
falsifiers: Any mixed scalar-value EXACT_ZOE class invalidates the harness because the frozen exact-type control must reproduce prior Q-V exactness.
Any mixed scalar-value REL_INC_ZOE class rejects REL_INC aggregation on that carrier.
Any mixed scalar-value TOPO_RPAR_ZOE class rejects TOPO_RPAR aggregation on that carrier.
MULTI failure rejects the exact component-multiset Q-V control.
interpretationGuards: A passing descriptor-aggregated ZOE key is a bounded Q-V quotient result, not Q-A or Q-F.
A descriptor may pass scalar value while discarding structural distinctions relevant to other targets.
No standard-7x6 or universal descriptor theorem follows.
nextIfCommonSuccess: Freeze the coarsest common scalar-exact descriptor aggregation, then qualify it unchanged on a fresh non-affine carrier before attempting a closed-form evaluator.
nextIfRelIncOnly: Retain REL_INC_ZOE as the current count-aware scalar descriptor and inspect the topology/release distinctions lost by TOPO_RPAR.
nextIfBothFail: Freeze the collision families and refine component identity only along the exact structural distinctions exposed by the failures; do not revert to arbitrary exact IDs.
nextIfExactZoeFails: Stop: this contradicts the established ZOE control and indicates a harness or representation mismatch.
